brief: Material packs for soft 3D brand icons (lime #9CDE45, deep green #33694F, warm off-whites). Ranked by fit. [U] = unverified.

best_picks.name: Sanctus Library (free tier → $39)
best_picks.why: Free test tier, 1800+ procedural materials, updated for 4.5–5.2, 180 ratings. Base library.

best_picks.name: Ultimate Plastic Shader + Clay Doh (DoubleGum)
best_picks.why: One master node each for plastic and clay, exact hex colour, Principled-based, 4.x–5.2. Covers soft-touch, candy gloss, clay – the core icon looks.

best_picks.name: Glass Studio (SkdSam, $10)
best_picks.why: Frosted/clear/coloured glass with dispersion from a HUD, 37 presets, Oct 2026. Closest to a liquid-glass kit.

best_picks.name: Iridescence (Egret Studios, $14.99)
best_picks.why: 2026 thin-film/holographic/anodized system with lighting rigs – accent finish layer.

packs.name: Sanctus Library – Procedural Materials
packs.author: Sanctus
packs.price: Free Essential set (100+ assets) / $25 non-commercial / $39 commercial / $150 10-seat
packs.licence: Add-on GPL; materials under per-tier licence (commercial tier needed for client work)
packs.type: Procedural add-on library (node groups + material editor, bake-to-PBR)
packs.inside: 1800+ materials/assets/tools; procedural shaders incl. plastics, glass, metals, fabrics, liquids (Liquid Works expansion), decals, GN generators. 180 ratings.
packs.hex_editable: yes – exposed colour inputs in node groups / material editor
packs.note: Widest base for a house library; very actively updated. Free tier is enough to test the plastics. Exact looks per category beyond plastic/glass/metal [U].

packs.name: Ultimate Plastic Shader
packs.author: DoubleGum (Rahul Parihar)
packs.type: Procedural single master node + presets (Principled BSDF based)
packs.inside: One node for all plastic types (matte, glossy, translucent [U]); sliders for fingerprints, dents, scratches; no UVs. 7 ratings (5★), 600+ sales.
packs.hex_editable: yes – base colour input on the master node
packs.note: Cleanest route to soft-touch and glossy toy plastic at exact hex. Turn imperfections down for icon cleanliness.

packs.name: Clay Doh – Tools & Shaders (Clay 4.Doh)
packs.author: DoubleGum (Rahul Parihar)
packs.type: Procedural master clay node + GN tools (Principled BSDF)
packs.inside: Clay presets (3.Doh + 4.Doh), fingerprints, cracks, sticky textures, stop-motion, Clay Text, Pottery tool. 106 ratings, 11 100+ sales; 4.Doh update Aug 2025.
packs.note: Best-in-class clay. For clean icons dial fingerprints/cracks to near zero to get smooth matte clay.

packs.name: Glass Studio
packs.author: SkdSam
packs.type: Add-on (radial HUD) generating procedural glass materials
packs.inside: 37 glass and mirror presets: clear, coloured, frosted; controls for colour, IOR, roughness, transmission, dispersion, coating; procedural frost, fingerprints, dust; save own library. Released 2 Oct 2026 – no reviews yet.
packs.note: Closest thing to a 'liquid/frosted glass' kit for icons. Brand-new: quality unproven [U].

packs.name: Iridescence – Physical Optics Material System
packs.author: Egret Studios LLC
packs.inside: 33 presets: holographic foils, soap bubble, oil slick, dichroic glass, nacre, anodized metals, stylised; 8 lighting rigs; bake maps. Published ~Sep 2026.
packs.hex_editable: partly – structural colour is physics-driven (film thickness/IOR); base tint editable [U]
packs.note: Most complete thin-film/holo system. Use as accent layer over lime/green base.

packs.name: Udin Blender Shaders
packs.author: Udin
packs.price: Free (60 base materials, all shaders) / $49.99 Pro (980+) / $499.99 Team
packs.inside: Plastic 232 (glossy, matte, rough, rubber, speckled, transparent glossy/matte, lens); Carpaint 230 (metallic, matte, satin, pearl, iridescent); Metal 44 (brushed, bead-blasted, anodized); Textile 360; Carbon 96.
packs.hex_editable: yes [U] – base materials are parametric; colour input not explicitly documented
packs.note: Industrial-design CMF library – ideal vocabulary for 'device-like' icons. Free tier worth testing first. Check 4.2+/5.x compatibility.

packs.name: Community Material Pack
packs.author: Curtis Holt
packs.inside: Community-contributed material set for the asset browser; 554 ratings, 5.0★. Exact count and list [U].
packs.note: Zero-risk CC0 starting point; contents not listed on page.

packs.name: 52+ Procedural Plastic & Rubber Materials
packs.author: Polynex
packs.type: Procedural smart materials (no textures, UV optional)
packs.inside: 52+ presets in Plastic, Rubber, Pattern categories; product-render oriented; soft rubber feel. Published ~Mar 2026.
packs.note: Cheap complement to Ultimate Plastic for rubber/soft-touch variants.

packs.name: Shaders Plus – Caustics, Thin Film, Dispersion (V4)
packs.author: SMOUSE
packs.inside: Real-time fake caustics, spectral dispersion, physically accurate thin-film. 44 ratings, 4600+ sales.
packs.note: Makes glass icons pop (coloured caustics on floor). Effect add-on rather than a look library.

packs.name: Car Paint Shader (Candy / Flakes / Iridescence)
packs.author: SBTien
packs.type: Procedural node group on one Principled BSDF
packs.inside: Base + metallic flakes + clearcoat, candy, pearl, colour-shift flakes; 2026 update split flakes node.
packs.hex_editable: yes – base and flake colours separate
packs.note: Gives glossy 'candy' lime with deep green flake shift. Turn flake scale down for small icons.

packs.name: Procedural Stylized Gradients Material Pack (#30)
packs.author: Ryan King Art
packs.inside: 10 stylized gradient materials (noise, swirl, wavy etc.) + 4 example project files.
packs.note: Only dedicated gradient pack found. Pipe into Emission for glowing icons.

packs.name: SF Metal – Procedural Metal Materials
packs.author: Starting Frame
packs.inside: 9 metals: brushed aluminium, brushed steel, gunmetal, polished chrome, gold, copper, scratched/rusty steel, shipwreck. Brushed grain renders in EEVEE. Published ~Aug 2026.
packs.note: Modern, clean brushed aluminium/chrome. Needs Blender 5.2. No anodized preset – tint brushed aluminium to #33694F.

packs.name: Woolly Tools & Shaders 2.0
packs.author: DoubleGum (Rahul Parihar)
packs.inside: One-click felt, fur, fuzz hair systems; knit/wool materials; auto base-colour detection. 48 ratings, 2800+ sales.
packs.hex_editable: yes – auto base colour from object material
packs.note: Best felt/fabric option for tactile icons. Heavier renders (hair).

packs.name: Ultimate Blender Procedural Material Pack
packs.author: Ryan King Art
packs.type: Procedural node groups, asset library with catalogs
packs.inside: Every Ryan King procedural material, growing with updates (192 at 2023 launch; current count [U]); catalogs incl. Clay, Plastic, Glass, Metal, Abstract, Gradients. 11 ratings, 700+ sales.
packs.hex_editable: yes – colour inputs on every node group
packs.note: Good value if you also want #28 plastics, #30 gradients, #32 frosted glass in one buy.

packs.name: Vizpak SSS for Blender
packs.author: Richard Yot
packs.inside: 50 translucent materials: plastics, rubbers, foods, stones, gems – physically researched SSS.
packs.hex_editable: partly – SSS colour/radius editable but tuned per material
packs.note: Only serious SSS/jelly library found. Not updated past 4.1; Principled SSS changed in 4.0 so verify on 4.5/5.x.

packs.name: Discover3D Starter Pack
packs.author: immchez
packs.licence: Commercial use with credit; no resale
packs.inside: 10 materials: clay (dry/wet), modelling dough, clear glass, frosted glass, plastic, translucent plastic, metal, damaged metal, concrete, wood; 5 lighting setups; sample scene.
packs.note: Small but almost exactly the icon look list, plus lighting rigs. Credit required.

packs.name: Holographic Shader Pack
packs.author: neoyume
packs.inside: 30 holographic sticker-style shaders; pattern scale, noise scale, tint.
packs.note: Free stylized holo foil for accents/stickers. og:image is a YouTube thumbnail.

packs.name: Advanced Material Pack
packs.author: heypictures
packs.inside: Large mixed set: plastic in 9 colours × glossy/matte/medium/thick/thin-SSS, glass, diamonds, emission with fresnel + animated patterns, ceramic patterns, metals (brushed, anisotropic, powder coat), fabrics, wool. 57 ratings, 5.0★.
packs.note: Cheap broad sampler; quality uneven but good for quick exploration.

packs.name: Extreme PBR Nexus
packs.author: Andrew_D
packs.licence: Add-on GPL; default library CC0 (per docs)
packs.type: Add-on + mostly texture-based PBR library (1 GB base, up to 185 GB Pro)
packs.inside: 1800+ materials, car paint with flakes, FX layers (wear), texture paint between materials, asset-browser export. 181 ratings, 11 400+ sales.
packs.hex_editable: partly – colour override available, but many are photo textures
packs.note: Strong for realism/archviz; less suited to clean stylized icons. Listed because it was requested.

packs.name: NiceGlass – Dispersion Glass Shader
packs.author: CG Meerkat
packs.inside: Glass shader with continuous dispersion and brighter internal illumination (fixes black patches at low bounces).
packs.note: Cheap fix for dark glass icons at low bounce counts.

packs.name: BlenderKit (Blendkit) – free tier
packs.author: BlenderKit community
packs.price: Free tier (~26 000 free materials) / Full Plan subscription
packs.licence: Per asset: Royalty Free or CC0 – check each
packs.type: Online library via add-on; mixed procedural and texture
packs.inside: Huge searchable library incl. many plastic, glass, metal, fabric materials with colour controls; no curated icon set.
packs.note: Good for one-off finds; no consistent 'pack'. Image is the BlenderKit logo (site og:image has no URL).

packs.name: ambientCG
packs.author: Lennart Demes
packs.inside: 2000+ PBR materials up to 8K; few clean plastics; mostly real-world surfaces (fabric, metal, leather).
packs.hex_editable: partly – albedo textures need Hue/Mix tint, not exact hex
packs.note: Use for fabric/felt bump or micro-texture maps layered under a procedural base.

packs.name: Poly Haven (Poly Haven Asset Browser add-on)
packs.author: Poly Haven
packs.inside: Scanned textures, models, HDRIs. Poly Haven deliberately makes no plastics.
packs.note: Not a material source for icons. Use only for studio HDRIs.

packs.name: Blender Procedural Metal Shader
packs.author: Mabel Design
packs.inside: 27 metals: aluminium polished/brushed/sanded/anodized, steel, gold, iron, bronze, copper, brass.
packs.note: Only cheap pack with anodized + brushed aluminium; old version tag – test on 5.x.

packs.name: Iridescence – Thin Film Shading
packs.author: Witting Graphics
packs.inside: Physically correct thin-film node, works in EEVEE; 15 premade materials (soap, oil, pearl, anodized, beetle).
packs.note: Alternative to Egret's Iridescence; Cycles now has native thin film, this adds EEVEE + control.

packs.name: Rexhue
packs.author: Rexhue
packs.inside: 40+ presets, 4 nodes: basic paint, flex paint, chameleon (ChromaFlair) and pearlescent paint.
packs.note: Cheap pearlescent/candy paint; version tag stops at 4.4.

packs.name: Procedural Ceramics Shader
packs.author: Secret Swim Club
packs.licence: Free for commercial and personal use
packs.inside: Ceramic glaze shader; V1 8 objects, V2 81 objects, secondary glaze colour, crackle, glaze thickness.
packs.note: Best ceramic option found; 10 ratings 5.0★.

packs.name: Glass Shaders Professional Pack
packs.author: mashud008
packs.inside: 57 glass materials incl. caustic/absorption.
packs.note: New, no ratings, generic marketing copy – quality unverified [U].

packs.name: Fuzzy Master: Realistic Felt Effects
packs.author: Lazy3D [U]
packs.inside: Felt fuzz for stop-motion look; 9 ratings, 500+ sales.
packs.note: Cheaper alternative to Woolly.
